blind.description: A stylized low-poly cartoon birch tree. It features an upright, pale beige/white trunk with dark brown horizontal birch-bark markings and knots, flaring into root flares at the base that sit directly on the ground. The canopy consists of several rounded, chunky, faceted foliage clumps in bright green, arranged in tiers spiraling upwards towards a tapered crown. Surfaces are solid, smooth-shaded low-poly meshes with painted texture details, completely intact with no floating pieces or structural breaks.
blind.from_above: An extreme close-up showing the faceted, polygonal green planes of the uppermost foliage clump filling almost the entire frame.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 times as tall as the scale figure (around 14-15 ft tall), with a canopy width slightly under the height of the figure (around 4-5 ft wide).
